text: New Era Cap, LLC is controlled by its founding Koch family, with private-equity firm ACON Investments holding a significant stake. In August 2024 it completed its acquisition of the '47 brand, with the combined company led by fourth-generation Koch family CEO Christopher H. Koch.
short: New Era is controlled by its founding Koch family, with ACON Investments a significant minority investor.

source.name: Reuters via Yahoo Finance Canada: New Era Cap to acquire '47 in lifestyle brand tie-up, sources say
source.quote: New Era is controlled by its founding family, and private equity firm ACON Investments holds a significant stake.
source.note: The same report says the company is led by Chris Koch, 'the fourth-generation scion of the family', and that it was preparing an IPO. No completed IPO was found in reporting checked up to October 2026.

additionalSources.name: PR Newswire: New Era Completes Acquisition of '47
additionalSources.quote: The combined company will be led by Christopher H. Koch, Chief Executive Officer of New Era, and the current New Era and '47 management teams.
additionalSources.note: New Era Cap's own release on completing the '47 acquisition; describes both as 'family-founded brands'.
